TACKLE.name: PING
TACKLE.spec: how many numbers there are (the length of the list)

SLAM.name: FLOOD
SLAM.spec: the list followed by itself (twice as long)

DOUBLE_SLAP.name: UNDO
DOUBLE_SLAP.spec: the numbers without the first one

FURY_ATTACK.name: SPAM
FURY_ATTACK.spec: a list of 5 copies of the first number

HEADBUTT.name: REBOOT
HEADBUTT.spec: the first number plus the last

HYPER_FANG.name: CRASH
HYPER_FANG.spec: the number at index (first number % number of numbers)

SLASH.name: TRUNCATE
SLASH.spec: the first half of the numbers (half rounded down)

GLARE.name: DEADLOCK
GLARE.spec: the middle number: the one at index (number of numbers ÷ 2, rounded down)

LEER.name: EXPOSE
LEER.spec: the index of the smallest number

TAIL_WHIP.name: DOWNGRADE
TAIL_WHIP.spec: the numbers without the last one

HARDEN.name: HARDEN
HARDEN.spec: each number written as a string, like 42 → '42' (a list of strings)

BIND.name: BIND
BIND.spec: the first and last number, as a list of two

WRAP.name: WRAP
WRAP.spec: the numbers wrapped in another list

GROWL.name: ERROR
GROWL.spec: the text 'ERROR ' followed by how many numbers there are, e.g. 'ERROR 3'

CAMOUFLAGE.name: SPOOF
CAMOUFLAGE.spec: the list with the first and last numbers swapped

SUPERSONIC.name: FEEDBACK
SUPERSONIC.spec: the sum of the first two numbers

DEFENSE_CURL.name: LOCKDOWN
DEFENSE_CURL.spec: a list holding only the first number

SCREECH.name: DISTORTION
SCREECH.spec: the numbers after the first half (the first half is half the length, rounded down)

DISABLE.name: DISABLE
DISABLE.spec: the last number minus the first

ENCORE.name: LOOP
ENCORE.spec: the counting numbers from 1 up to the length of the list ([1, 2, 3, …])

SWEET_SCENT.name: LURE
SWEET_SCENT.spec: the even numbers, in their order

DOUBLE_TEAM.name: MIRROR
DOUBLE_TEAM.spec: the list followed by the same list reversed

FOCUS_ENERGY.name: COMPILE
FOCUS_ENERGY.spec: the numbers joined into one string with nothing between them

FOLLOW_ME.name: REDIRECT
FOLLOW_ME.spec: the index of the last number

FORESIGHT.name: BREAKPOINT
FORESIGHT.spec: the indexes of the numbers greater than 100

HELPING_HAND.name: SYNC
HELPING_HAND.spec: the first number times the second number

MINIMIZE.name: MINIMIZE
MINIMIZE.spec: the list with its middle number removed (the one at index number of numbers ÷ 2, rounded down)

RAGE.name: ECHO
RAGE.spec: add up all the numbers, then add up the digits of that total (532 → 10)

THRASH.name: THRASH
THRASH.spec: the list followed by itself twice (three times as long)

RAPID_SPIN.name: SPINUP
RAPID_SPIN.spec: the numbers with the first one moved to the end

RECOVER.name: RECOVER
RECOVER.spec: how many numbers are greater than 50

WHIRLWIND.name: FAILOVER
WHIRLWIND.spec: the numbers with the last one moved to the front

GROWTH.name: UPGRADE
GROWTH.spec: the list with one extra number at the end: how many numbers there were

WATER_PULSE.name: FILTER
WATER_PULSE.spec: the numbers that are 50 or more (the ones under 50 dropped)

WATER_SPORT.name: THROTTLE
WATER_SPORT.spec: the numbers up to, but not including, the first one over 100 (all of them if none is)

SPORE.name: STANDBY
SPORE.spec: each number repeated twice, in order ([1, 2] → [1, 1, 2, 2])

RAZOR_LEAF.name: SHARDS
RAZOR_LEAF.spec: the numbers split into two halves, as a list of two lists (the first half is half the length, rounded down)

LEECH_SEED.name: LEECH SEED
LEECH_SEED.spec: the sum of the numbers at even indexes (0, 2, 4…)

THUNDER_WAVE.name: POWERCUT
THUNDER_WAVE.spec: the numbers in their order, without the largest one

SPARK.name: SPARK
SPARK.spec: the largest number minus the smallest

ICICLE_SPEAR.name: SNAPSHOT
ICICLE_SPEAR.spec: a copy of the numbers, unchanged

KARATE_CHOP.name: OVERCLOCK
KARATE_CHOP.spec: the sum of every number squared

REVENGE.name: REWIND
REVENGE.spec: the numbers over 50, last to first

POISON_STING.name: INJECT
POISON_STING.spec: the list with one extra number, 1, appended at the end

SLUDGE.name: MALWARE
SLUDGE.spec: every number plus the first number

SMOG.name: SWARM
SMOG.spec: the sum of only the numbers greater than 100

POISON_GAS.name: TROJAN
POISON_GAS.spec: the list with a copy of its largest number added at the front

SAND_ATTACK.name: SANDBOX
SAND_ATTACK.spec: each number capped at 100 (numbers over 100 become 100)

MAGNITUDE.name: RNG
MAGNITUDE.spec: the sum of the numbers mod 10

MUD_SPORT.name: GROUND
MUD_SPORT.spec: each number capped at 128 (numbers over 128 become 128)

PECK.name: FETCH
PECK.spec: the numbers as a JSON string, like [42,13,140]

WING_ATTACK.name: UPLOAD
WING_ATTACK.spec: the numbers joined into one string with '-' between them

GUST.name: BROADCAST
GUST.spec: a list as long as the input where every entry is the first number

HYPNOSIS.name: SUSPEND
HYPNOSIS.spec: the index of the largest number

CONFUSION.name: SCRAMBLE
CONFUSION.spec: the numbers sorted from largest to smallest

PSYBEAM.name: SMUDGE
PSYBEAM.spec: every number rounded to the nearest 10 (5 rounds up)

REFLECT.name: REFLECT
REFLECT.spec: each number mirrored around 100: 200 minus the number

LEECH_LIFE.name: LEAK
LEECH_LIFE.spec: the sum of the last two numbers

STRING_SHOT.name: SKIP
STRING_SHOT.spec: the list with its first number added again at the end

TWINEEDLE.name: DOUBLE
TWINEEDLE.spec: the first number, twice (a list of two)

ROCK_TOMB.name: BRICK
ROCK_TOMB.spec: the numbers sorted from smallest to largest

ROLLOUT.name: ROLLOUT
ROLLOUT.spec: the running totals (first number, first two summed, first three…)

ASTONISH.name: POPUP
ASTONISH.spec: the numbers except the first and the last (the ones hidden in the middle)

DRAGON_RAGE.name: MELTDOWN
DRAGON_RAGE.spec: the length of the list times 10

PURSUIT.name: TRACE
PURSUIT.spec: the index of the first number over 100 (-1 if none)

METAL_CLAW.name: HASH
METAL_CLAW.spec: the sum of the numbers mod 256
